universal_patterns.pattern: all occupational and professional licen[sc]ees?[^.]*regulated under the Indiana Code
entities described in IC 25-0\.5-3 that regulate occupations or professions

proposal.rationale: The undetermined sections in Article 0.5 follow a consistent enumeration template: each section says "IC 25-1-1.1-4 applies to an individual licensed [or certified] under IC 25-XX (profession name)." These are profession-by-profession enumerations of which practice-act articles the umbrella initial-license rule (IC 25-1-1.1-4) applies to. To capture these, I added two new trigger patterns: "licensed or certified under" (to catch the 25-0.5-1-8 form and similar) and direct triggers on "IC 25-1-1.1-4 applies to" / "IC 25-1-2-2.1 applies to" so the walker scans forward from those phrases for the article cite that follows (e.g., "IC 25-19"). These let the walker enumerate each profession's article as covered by the umbrella. Universal patterns are unchanged — the Article 0.5 sections are deliberately profession-specific enumerations, not universal declarations, so they should be picked up via triggers rather than universal patterns.
